items.name: "MOMBAN YATTERO" TO IWARE 15 NEN, TSUTTATETTERU MA NI ORE NO MARYOKU GA 9999 "SAIKYO" NI SODATTEMASHITA
items.other_name: 「門番やってろ」と言われ15年、突っ立ってる間に俺の魔力が9999（最強）に育ってました, 「門番やってろ」と言われ15年、突っ立ってる間に俺の魔力が9999〈最強〉に育ってました, 未定义
items.description: Although Royle is blessed with a good physique, he was told that he had no talent for fighting, and was forced to work as a lonely gatekeeper for 15 years. While he is working, all he can do is fantasize about the adventure stories in which he is the main character, and his job as gatekeeper is replaced by an "automatic surveillance interception magic tool" and he is laid off.Loyle is at a loss, but along the way he meets the saint Diz. After meeting her, he discovers that the "strongest original magic" that was available in her delusions can be used in reality...An exhilarating story about the strongest man with no communication skills and 9999 magic power who becomes an adventurer and becomes unrivaled!

items.name: INFINITE DENDROGRAM - RAW
items.other_name: インフィニット・デンドログラム (Novel), ＜Infinite Dendrogram＞-インフィニット・デンドログラム- (Novel), 无限分歧树 - RAW
items.description:
July 15, 2043. On that day, a Full Dive VRMMO was released, its unique system called ＜Embryo＞ allowing each player to follow an extremely varied—or rather, an “infinitely” varied pattern of evolution. That game’s name?

＜Infinite Dendrogram＞

Possessing an element that, until now, had never been achieved by VRMMOs and was considered a technical impossibility, ＜Infinite Dendrogram＞ took over the entire world, becoming a major hit in the blink of an eye.

One and a half year had passed since the launch of ＜Infinite Dendrogram＞. A young man named Mukudori Reiji had finished his university entrance exams and began living alone in Tokyo. In order to celebrate the end of that lengthy studying period, after being invited by his older brother long ago, he finally started playing the game.

This is a story where the line between game and reality is blurred.

And also, a tale of reminiscences.
